description: This file defines the ModelFieldType class, which models a field type in the Apache OFBiz entity framework. It includes properties such as type, javaType, sqlType, and sqlTypeAlias, and methods for constructing instances from XML elements, retrieving properties, and determining string length based on SQL type.

classes.name: ModelFieldType
classes.description: Models a database field type within OFBiz, encapsulating type information and JDBC handling.

methods.name: ModelFieldType
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ModelFieldType object from an XML element, extracting attributes such as type, javaType, sqlType, and sqlTypeAlias, and setting up the JDBC value handler.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the string representing the type of the field.

methods.name: getJavaType
methods.description: Returns the Java class type of the field.

methods.name: getJdbcValueHandler
methods.description: Returns the JdbcValueHandler instance associated with this field type.

methods.name: getSqlType
methods.description: Returns the SQL type of the field.

methods.name: getSqlTypeAlias
methods.description: Returns the optional SQL type alias.

methods.name: stringLength
methods.description: Estimates the maximum string length for representing data of this field type based on its SQL type.

search-terms: Java class for entity model field
